snippet.title: Rus: source - game trailer
snippet.description:
You remember neither your name, where you came from, nor why you ended up in the past.

It is up to you to decide who you are. But fate has other plans for you. You become Rurik and find yourself in the thick of the 862 events. His life is yours. However, it's not that simple: people are mortal, and power is ephemeral. The story will not end with one knyaz – it will definitely continue in Oleg, Igor and Olga.

This is a historical visual novel with RPG-elements. It is based on the history of Ancient Russia, recreated from chronicles and archaeological artefacts. Moreover, to connect the plot of the four stories, there are elements of fiction, meta-humor and a separate lore that will be revealed as the story progresses. And according to your curiosity.
